hook: You're Holding Your Breath. Right Now.

voices.name: l00
voices.text: While you're watching this, <#0.2#> you might be holding your breath.
voices.caption: While you're watching this, you might be holding your breath.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: When we stare at a screen or read a message, <#0.2#> we stop breathing without noticing.
voices.caption: When we stare at a screen or read a message, we stop breathing without noticing.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: When your breath gets shallow or stops, <#0.2#> your body can't let go of tension. <#0.2#> That's why you feel drained all day.
voices.caption: When your breath gets shallow or stops, your body can't let go of tension. That's why you feel drained all day.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: Drop your shoulders. <#0.3#> Breathe in slowly through your nose. <#0.3#> And breathe out, long and slow.
voices.caption: Drop your shoulders → slow inhale through the nose → long exhale

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Once an hour, <#0.2#> that one breath is enough.
voices.caption: Once an hour, that one breath is enough.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: How was that? <#0.3#> Your body just loosened a little, didn't it?
voices.caption: How was that? Your body just loosened a little, didn't it?
